SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  "fileName",
  "originalName",
  "filePath",
  "fileSize",
  "fileType",
  "mimeType",
  type,
  "isUploaded",
  "isRead",
  "isIngested",
  "uploadedAt",
  "requestId",
  "hashType",
  hash,
  fid,
  "itemId",
  "sourceId",
  "contextId",
  "errorMessage",
  "isValidFile"
FROM public."FileDetails"
WHERE "isValidFile" = 'false'
LIMIT 1000;
